notes: BETA 2.28.92. The engineer now talks to you like a person: small talk, jokes and questions about racing or anything else get a real answer in his personality instead of 'focus on your driving', and he only cuts in with a warning when something is actually urgent. A question like 'should I put ABS on 3?' is now answered as advice instead of changing the car. Game sound: the microphone can no longer stay open forever (30 second limit), a Bluetooth headset microphone is no longer tried automatically (it switched headsets into call mode and muted the game), your microphone choice is remembered by name, and the update window no longer pops up over a running game and steals its focus. Assetto Corsa: PitWise wrote wrong keys into controls.ini (Escape raised ABS, Enter TC, arrows changed brake bias) - it now uses the correct key codes and repairs the old entries itself; the lights command uses your headlights key. Key presses can never hit mute, volume or the Windows key. The voice command 'add 30 litres for 10 laps' works again. iRacing: no UI freeze when the Nordschleife map loads, maps for short ovals, no false gaps after switching from ACC, the car dot stays put in the garage. If Google's AI is overloaded, a lighter model is tried before the offline answer. As before, none of this has been tested on track yet - please report anything odd with the feedback form in the app.
